onset.Description: Start (s) of the trial's 9.002 s epoch within the concatenated file. Source epochs span -2.0 to +7.0 s (4609 samples at 512 Hz) relative to the onset of the first operand N1 (source D.time; trialsData_readme (data-structure description in Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19550714 raw_data.zip)), so N1 onset = onset + 2.0 s.

duration.Description: Length of one source epoch, 4609 samples / 512 Hz = 9.001953125 s.

sample.Description: The event onset time in number of sampling points.First sample is 0.

value.Description: Integer event ID assigned by the BIDS writer (MNE-BIDS) to each trial_type; equals the trial index.

trial_type.Description: Positional trial index 'trial-NNN' = NNN-th trial (third dimension) of the source D.trials array, which is also row NNN of the source D.stimuliValues table (N1, N2, N3, O1, O2, RT, stimType; not exported here). Not stimulus content.
